title: Kimi K3 Builds Exceptional Websites
description:
Average input gets average output.

That's just how the model works.

Ask for a website.

You get the median one.

It averages everything it's seen.

So you specify away from that.

Name the layout you want.

Name what you don't.

That's the whole difference.

It's like ordering food with no preferences.

You get whatever the kitchen defaults to.

The model isn't holding you back.

Your brief is.

Write a sharper one tonight.

#kimik3 #websites #webdesign #prompting #design
